E-waste recycling Malaysia

OLD ELECTRONICS, A CLEAR NEXT STEP
Free
e-waste
pickup
for
homes.
Bulk
collection
for
offices.

Whether you want to get paid for recycling old electronics or arrange an office clear-out, choose the collection option that fits your needs.

Clearing out a phone or laptop?

Request collection for your old electronics with a minimum of 3 devices. Share the device type and condition so the team can discuss what you have before pickup.

Retiring office equipment?

Tell us your equipment types, estimated volume and collection address. Business pickup is quoted separately from free household collection.

Need certified data destruction?

Businesses can request certified data destruction and compliance documents. Discuss the data-bearing devices and records you need when requesting a quote.

Request a Pickup
TRACK & TRACE
Request Your Certificate or Status.

Look up a collection or request documentation — a certificate of destruction, an ESG diversion report, or a status update — and we'll get back to you.

WHAT YOU CAN REQUEST
Documentation
for
Any
Collection

Whether it was a free individual pickup or a bulk enterprise collection, you can request the paperwork that goes with it.

Certificate of Destruction

Serialized proof that a data-bearing device was destroyed to a certified standard — available for bulk and enterprise collections, and on request for individual pickups.

ESG Diversion Report

Tonnage recycled and landfill diverted for a collection, formatted for your sustainability or donor reporting.

Collection Status Update

Not sure where things stand on a booked or recent pickup? Send us your reference and we'll confirm.
